title: Home energy review
note: Historical public data (one house, January to May 2016, energy logged every 10 minutes, via the UCI Machine Learning Repository). Not a deployment and not a user.

goal.text: Notice the weeks when the appliances run heavy, before the bill does.

commitments.text: Look at which appliances ran long this week.
Keep monitoring; no action this week.

facts.heavy_rule: Heavy days are days whose high use intervals exceed the declared limit.
facts.high_use_rule: High use intervals are logged intervals whose appliance energy use exceeds the declared amount.
facts.light_rule: Light intervals are logged intervals with the lights on.
facts.source: The records come from the UCI Appliances Energy Prediction dataset, under a Creative Commons Attribution license.
